title: In Vermont, small town meetings grapple with debate on big issues
summary: Typically concerned with local issues, residents at town meetings in Vermont and elsewhere increasingly use the forum to debate polarizing national and international events.
contentText:
Municipalities in New England and elsewhere are increasingly grappling with major national and international issues at the local level.'/> Typically concerned with local issues, residents at town meetings in Vermont and elsewhere increasingly use the forum to debate polarizing national and international events.
